INSERT INTO reactions
                (userid, postid, emojiname, createat, updateat, deleteat, remoteid, channelid)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
            ON CONFLICT (userid, postid, emojiname)
                DO UPDATE SET updateat  = $5,
                              deleteat  = $6,
                              remoteid  = $7,
                              channelid = $8
